# WefieHome

> WefieHome is a Kuala Lumpur-based short-term rental property management company operating across Kuala Lumpur and Klang Valley, Malaysia, since March 2018. It manages short-stay properties (Airbnb) for property owners and offers professionally managed stays to guests. Positioning: professional short-term rental management with long-term property care. Tagline: STAY HAPPY.

Key facts (re-verified periodically):
- Brand: WefieHome — a brand operated by Think Bright PLT. Founder & Managing Director: Ivan Ng.
- Service: short-term rental management (also searched as "Airbnb management") for property owners in Kuala Lumpur and Klang Valley.
- Current portfolio: 18 active units across six properties (J Dupion Residence, M Vertica, Trion KL, Arte Cheras, Nexus Taman Pertama, Shah Alam Section 8). More than 20 properties managed since 2018.
- Track record: 5,000+ guests, 10,000+ nights; Airbnb Superhost, 4.85/5 rating across 1,000+ reviews.
- Management model: 20% of defined gross revenue (platform payout after platform and cleaning fees, before WefieHome's fee); no upfront management fee; 12-month agreement with automatic renewal (owners can ask to end it anytime, after confirmed bookings are completed); monthly owner payout and report. Exact terms follow the signed management agreement.
- Office (not a rental property): 30-2, Jalan 24/70A, Desa Sri Hartamas, 50480 Kuala Lumpur. Phone/WhatsApp +60 19-482 4292. Email contact@wefiehome.com.
- Guests book all stays on Airbnb: https://www.airbnb.com/p/ivanng

## Owner guides
- [Owner Guides](https://wefiehome.com/owners/): hub of guides for owners of new condo projects in Kuala Lumpur.
- [Maxim Risen Owner Guide](https://wefiehome.com/owners/maxim-risen/): WefieHome works with a maximum of 12 Maxim Risen (Cheras) owner partners; guidance from VP to Airbnb management; 20% management fee, no upfront fee; WefieHome is independent of the developer.
- [J Dupion Residence Owner Guide](https://wefiehome.com/owners/j-dupion-residence/): WefieHome has managed Airbnb units at J Dupion Residence (also called JD or JD Residence), Jalan Sembilang, Cheras since 2018 and manages 7 units there (six 2-bedroom, one 3-bedroom); 20% management fee, no upfront fee; independent of the developer and building management.
- [M Vertica Owner Guide](https://wefiehome.com/owners/m-vertica/): WefieHome has managed short-stay units at M Vertica (MV), Mah Sing's development next to Maluri MRT in Cheras, since 2022 and looks after 5 three-bedroom units there — guests, cleaning, upkeep and monthly owner reports; 20% management fee, no upfront fee; independent of the developer.
- [Arte Cheras Owner Guide](https://wefiehome.com/owners/arte-cheras/): WefieHome has managed short-stay units at Arte Cheras (Jalan Midah 2, Taman Midah, Cheras; about 400 m from Taman Midah MRT) since 2023 and runs 2 loft units there (2-bedroom + loft, usually set up for 6 guests); 20% management fee with revenue sharing, no upfront management fee; independent of the developer and building management.
- [Trion KL Owner Guide](https://wefiehome.com/owners/trion-kl/): WefieHome has managed short-stay units at Trion KL (Jalan Sungai Besi, Chan Sow Lin, Kuala Lumpur; walking distance to Chan Sow Lin station) since 2023 and runs 2 high-floor units there with Merdeka 118 and KL skyline views (a 3-bedroom for 6 guests, furnished and styled by WefieHome, and an owner-furnished 2-bedroom for 4 guests); 20% management fee with revenue sharing, no upfront management fee; independent of the developer and building management.
- [Landed Home Owner Guide](https://wefiehome.com/owners/landed-homes/): For owners of semi-detached houses and bungalows (terrace houses also accepted) in Kuala Lumpur and Klang Valley, WefieHome runs the home as a short-term rental and looks after the property itself (inspections, cleaning, maintenance and repair coordination, monthly owner reports); owners can still use the house; WefieHome runs a double-storey landed house in Section 8, Shah Alam that sleeps 8 guests; 20% management fee with revenue sharing, no upfront management fee.
- [Partner with WefieHome](https://wefiehome.com/partners/): For property agents, developers, interior designers and renovators, lawyers and mortgage bankers, investors and multi-unit landlords, and education or long-stay agencies in Kuala Lumpur and Klang Valley who want to collaborate with WefieHome; condos and landed homes welcome; every partnership discussed one-to-one with founder Ivan Ng via WhatsApp.
- [Skyline Embassy Owner Guide](https://wefiehome.com/owners/skyline-embassy/): for owners at Skyline Embassy (TSLAW Land, Jalan Ampang, about 950 m from KLCC; VP in progress) — WefieHome is a small, founder-led operator: founder Ivan inspects units himself, owners WhatsApp him directly, each unit is set up individually and only a limited number of units are taken on; strategy for unit Types A–F including twin-key; 20% management fee, no upfront fee; independent of the developer; units insured, every guest ID-checked, owners can ask to end the agreement anytime after confirmed bookings are completed. Also in Simplified Chinese (https://wefiehome.com/owners/skyline-embassy/zh-hans/) and Traditional Chinese (https://wefiehome.com/owners/skyline-embassy/zh-hant/).
- [Meet WefieHome (1-minute intro)](https://wefiehome.com/intro/): short introduction for property owners — founder-run Airbnb management in Kuala Lumpur since 2018, 20+ properties managed, Airbnb Superhost 4.85★; 20% management fee (revenue sharing), no upfront management fee; contact Ivan on WhatsApp.
